name: LEGRADA
description:
About This Game

A few squares from victory. Then your rival places a wall.

LEGRADA is an online board game for two: find your way across the board, send your rival on a detour, and reach the opposite edge first. If you enjoy Quoridor, the battle over every step will feel familiar. Here, though, your pieces have elemental abilities. Your perfect plan might have a weakness you didn't see coming.

Take a step. Place a wall.

Move closer to the finish, or spend your turn slowing your rival down? Every turn asks you to choose. Place walls, keep a route open, and work out who has the shorter path. You can't trap a piece completely. You can send it halfway around the board.

Nice plan. Shame it's on fire.

Burn the wall your rival was counting on. Freeze them just short of the finish. Dash ahead when they think they've already won. Seven elements give you different ways to change a match, from placing two walls in one turn to jumping diagonally. Choosing an ability is only half the challenge. Knowing when to use it is the other half.

Different materials. Their own leitana.

These figurines are carved from different materials in the likeness of Lekamons, creatures that inhabit the game's world. Each holds its own leitana: some are imbued with the power of a Fire crystal, others with Water. The element determines the figurine's ability on the board. Open spheres, build your collection, and choose a figurine to suit your tactics.

One more game?

Play online one-on-one or create a room for a friend. Choose matches with abilities, or play Classic mode, where steps and walls decide the outcome. Practice new tactics against an AI opponent, then put them to the test in your next duel.

A cozy board. A troublesome rival. Your move.
short_desc: LEGRADA is a tactical board game with online 1v1 duels. Place walls, force your opponent to take a detour, and reach the opposite side first. Collect Lekamon figurines, wield abilities from seven elements, or play Classic mode without abilities.
